outputs.explanation: Panel A contains H&E micrographs and spatial transcriptomic expression plots showing per-spot expression data across tissue sections; this is not a summary/average bar plot type requiring overlaid individual data points.
Panel B consists of H&E and RNAscope fluorescence micrographs only, with no averaged plot presented.

Panel C is a scatter/dot plot in which every individual patient tumor sample (LUAD n=512, LUSC n=500) is plotted as a single point, with median and 95% CI shown on top — individual data points are displayed.
Panel D is a bar chart (mean ± SD) with the individual replicate data points (n=3 per group) overlaid as dots.
